hook: Data do jagah, answer ek jagah: [[JOIN]] ka jaadu

slides.title: Data [[alag]] kyun rakha?
points: Har order mein customer ka naam-city **repeat**? Nahi!
slides.note: Isko bolte hain **normalization**: duplicate data = kam 🧹

slides.title: Table 2: [[orders]]
slides.note: Sawaal: "order 101 **kisne** kiya?" Naam to customers mein hai! 🤔

slides.title: JOIN se [[jodo]]
slides.code:
SELECT *
FROM customers
JOIN orders
  ON customers.id =
     orders.customer_id;

slides.title: JOIN ke [[4 bhai]]
slides.note: Agle 4 parts mein ek-ek bhai se **milenge** 😎

slides.right:
SELECT *
FROM customers
JOIN orders
  ON customers.id = orders.customer_id;
slides.why: ON bhoole: PostgreSQL **error**, MySQL har row × har row jod deta 💥
